description: Renovate for airlock-hass-addons (replaces Dependabot), run by the homelab cluster's CronJob.
It keeps the workflows' actions and the add-on's base image current; the connector image is
the connector-bump workflow's (cosign and smoke-tested), never Renovate's. A release waits 7 days

customManagers.description: The community add-on base, pinned by the digest of its :stable index (one digest serves both architectures).

packageRules.description: The connector image: the connector-bump workflow repins it and cuts the release.
The base: both architectures in one PR; Home Assistant rebuilds an add-on only on a version bump.
prBodyNotes: Home Assistant rebuilds the add-on only on a new version: bump `version` in airlock-connector/config.yaml and add a CHANGELOG entry in this PR before merging.

packageRules.description: The workflows' actions in one PR.
